popup.$description: Popup: the surface menus and drop-downs open on, above the page.

list-box.$description: A list box inside a popup: the surface is its frame, so by default the list draws none of its own (no frame, fill or shadow).

with-list.$description: A popup holding a list or a list box: its own padding there (designs often take it away and let the list's items reach the edge). General: any owner's own place outweighs it.

list.$description: A list right in a popup: its margin and padding there, and its items' height and corners.

list-box-space.$description: A list box in a popup: its margin and padding there.

surface.$description: The surface menus and drop-downs open on; `focus`: the keys moved focus onto the surface itself (a ring).
